Tape the various areas shown in the figure with masking tape.

Conduct a road test gradually bringing the car up to the noise where the noise starts: if the noise persists, check the sealant between the wing and pillar, at the bottom.

Remove the masking tape from area A and repeat the road test: if the noise persists, check the condition of the door seal in that area and that it is firmly attached to the bodywork (see PROCEDURES OP. 7005A34); also check the condition of the the bonnet hinge buffer.

Remove the masking tape from area B and repeat the road test: if the noise persists, check the condition of the door seal in that area and that it is firmly attached to the bodywork (see PROCEDURES OP. 7005A34).

Also check the door hinges (see PROCEDURES OP. 7005A14). Remove shims from the top hinge, or add shims to the bottom hinge, so that the door adheres better to the seal.

Remove the masking tape from area C and repeat the road test: if the noise persists, adjust the door hinges (see PROCEDURES OP. 7005A14). Remove or add shims on the two hinges, to make the door adhere better to the seal.

Remove the masking tape from area D and repeat the road test: if the noise persists, check the condition of the window glass seal (see PROCEDURES OP. 7005D26).

Remove the masking tape from the rear view mirror (area E) and repeat the road test: if the noise persists, check the condition of the mirror seal (see PROCEDURES OP. 7005R30).
